count_lines_insert.name: count_lines_insert
count_lines_insert.withCheck: (public.has_role(location_id, array['owner', 'manager', 'staff']::public.member_role[]) and exists (select 1 from public.count_sessions s where s.id = "count_lines"."session_id" and s.location_id = "count_lines"."location_id" and s.status = 'draft' and s.counted_by = public.current_user_id())) or public.has_role(location_id, array['owner', 'manager']::public.member_role[])

count_lines_update.name: count_lines_update
count_lines_update.using: (public.has_role(location_id, array['owner', 'manager', 'staff']::public.member_role[]) and exists (select 1 from public.count_sessions s where s.id = "count_lines"."session_id" and s.location_id = "count_lines"."location_id" and s.status = 'draft' and s.counted_by = public.current_user_id())) or public.has_role(location_id, array['owner', 'manager']::public.member_role[])
count_lines_update.withCheck: (public.has_role(location_id, array['owner', 'manager', 'staff']::public.member_role[]) and exists (select 1 from public.count_sessions s where s.id = "count_lines"."session_id" and s.location_id = "count_lines"."location_id" and s.status = 'draft' and s.counted_by = public.current_user_id())) or public.has_role(location_id, array['owner', 'manager']::public.member_role[])

count_lines_delete.name: count_lines_delete
count_lines_delete.using: (public.has_role(location_id, array['owner', 'manager', 'staff']::public.member_role[]) and exists (select 1 from public.count_sessions s where s.id = "count_lines"."session_id" and s.location_id = "count_lines"."location_id" and s.status = 'draft' and s.counted_by = public.current_user_id())) or (public.has_role(location_id, array['owner', 'manager']::public.member_role[]) and exists (select 1 from public.count_sessions s where s.id = "count_lines"."session_id" and s.location_id = "count_lines"."location_id" and s.status <> 'approved'))

count_sessions_insert_own.name: count_sessions_insert_own
count_sessions_insert_own.withCheck: public.has_role(location_id, array['owner', 'manager', 'staff']::public.member_role[]) and "count_sessions"."counted_by" = public.current_user_id() and "count_sessions"."status" in ('draft', 'submitted') and "count_sessions"."approved_by" is null

count_sessions_update_own_draft.name: count_sessions_update_own_draft
count_sessions_update_own_draft.withCheck: "count_sessions"."counted_by" = public.current_user_id() and "count_sessions"."status" in ('draft', 'submitted') and "count_sessions"."approved_by" is null

count_sessions_delete_draft.name: count_sessions_delete_draft
count_sessions_delete_draft.using: "count_sessions"."status" = 'draft' and ((public.has_role(location_id, array['owner', 'manager', 'staff']::public.member_role[]) and "count_sessions"."counted_by" = public.current_user_id()) or public.has_role(location_id, array['owner', 'manager']::public.member_role[]))

count_sessions_reviewed_has_reviewer.name: count_sessions_reviewed_has_reviewer
count_sessions_reviewed_has_reviewer.value: "count_sessions"."status" not in ('approved', 'rejected') or "count_sessions"."approved_at" is not null

stock_movements_insert_by_type.name: stock_movements_insert_by_type
stock_movements_insert_by_type.withCheck: (type in ('sale', 'count_adjust') and public.has_role(location_id, array['owner', 'manager']::public.member_role[])) or (type in ('delivery', 'waste') and public.has_role(location_id, array['owner', 'manager', 'staff']::public.member_role[]))

recipe_lines_confirmed_has_ingredient.name: recipe_lines_confirmed_has_ingredient
recipe_lines_confirmed_has_ingredient.value: "recipe_lines"."confirmed_at" is null or "recipe_lines"."ingredient_id" is not null

sales_imports_photo_has_path_and_date.name: sales_imports_photo_has_path_and_date
sales_imports_photo_has_path_and_date.value: "sales_imports"."source" <> 'photo' or ("sales_imports"."photo_path" is not null and "sales_imports"."business_date" is not null)

organizations_select_member.name: organizations_select_member
organizations_select_member.using: exists (select 1 from public.locations l where l.org_id = organizations.id and public.is_member(l.id))

organizations_update_owner.name: organizations_update_owner
organizations_update_owner.using: exists (select 1 from public.locations l where l.org_id = organizations.id and public.has_role(l.id, array['owner']::public.member_role[]))
organizations_update_owner.withCheck: exists (select 1 from public.locations l where l.org_id = organizations.id and public.has_role(l.id, array['owner']::public.member_role[]))
